name: Tucker Craig
intro: Hello, world! I'm Tucker. A lot of what I build starts with something small that bugs me. I wanted a browser with the features I like and none of the usual bloat, so I built angl browser. I wanted to keep track of my AI usage, so I built Pace Bar. I didn't want to keep paying for voice-to-text, so I made my own. I wanted my coding agents with me away from my desk, so now they're on my phone. Even something to help me get the right movie seat. There's a bunch more on my projects page. Feel free to check it out.
personal: I also sang a cappella in The Nuances at Davidson.
currentWork: Right now I'm building tools for myself across Mac, Windows, and iOS, plus writing firmware for a little Arduino handheld called omalo.
